name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme (Karnataka)
department: Department of Women and Child Development, Govt of Karnataka
short_description: Financial assistance of Rs. 2,000 per month to the woman head of household in Karnataka.
detailed_description: Gruha Lakshmi is one of the flagship guarantee schemes of the Government of Karnataka, providing monthly financial assistance of Rs. 2,000 directly transferred to the bank account of the woman designated as head of the family on Antyodaya, BPL, and APL ration cards.
description_kannada: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಗ್ಯಾರಂಟಿ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಬಿಪಿಎಲ್/ಎಪಿಎಲ್ ಪಡಿತರ ಚೀಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಯಜಮಾನಿ ಎಂದು ಗುರುತಿಸಲಾದ ಮಹಿಳೆಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ರೂ. 2,000 ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು ನೀಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

rules.name: Resident of Karnataka
rules.source_citation: Govt of Karnataka Order No. WCD 129 MPS 2023, Dated 05-06-2023
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you a permanent resident of Karnataka?

rules.name: Must be Female Head of Family
rules.source_citation: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme Rules, Section 3 (Eligibility of Female Head)
rules.clarification_question_en: Is the applicant the female head of the household?

rules.name: Minimum Age 18
rules.clarification_question_en: What is the age of the female applicant?

benefits_summary: Direct benefit transfer of Rs. 2,000 every month into the Aadhaar-linked bank account.
required_documents: Ration Card with woman specified as Head of Family
Aadhaar Card of the applicant woman
Bank passbook with Aadhaar-seeded NPCI mapping
application_process: Visit the nearest Grama One, Karnataka One, or Bangalore One centre, or apply on Seva Sindhu portal.
Provide Ration Card number and Aadhaar details.
Receive SMS confirmation with application acknowledgement number.
source_title: Seva Sindhu Guarantee Schemes Portal, Government of Karnataka
source_excerpt: Financial assistance of Rs. 2,000 per month is provided to women heads of families in Karnataka who hold Antyodaya, BPL, or APL cards, excluding income tax payees.
